notifications.subject: [URGENT] Shipment SHP-882 — Route Change & Updated Delivery Time
notifications.message:
SUBJECT: URGENT — SHP-882 Insulin Shipment Rerouted Due to N-5 Closure

Dear Pharmacy Admin,

We are writing to inform you that your critical insulin shipment (SHP-882, $50,000 value) has been rerouted due to an emergency on the N-5 National Highway.

What Happened:
The N-5 National Highway near Hyderabad West Bypass (KM 12.4) is closed due to a water main burst. The closure is in effect from 14:30–18:00 PKT (16 May 2026). Simultaneously, an extreme heat advisory (43°C peak, 48°C heat index) has been issued for the region, creating critical thermal risk for temperature-sensitive cargo.

New Route & ETA:
Your shipment is now routing via M-9 Thatta Bypass with a mandatory cold-vault thermal reset at Hyderabad Cold-Vault. This ensures the insulin maintains safe temperature during the peak heat window and avoids the N-5 closure entirely.

Original ETA: 14:30 PKT (40 minutes from alert time)
New ETA: 14:55–15:10 PKT (52 minutes from alert time)
Cold-Vault Stop: 10 minutes (thermal transfer only)

Final Destination: Liaquat Hospital, Jamshoro (unchanged)

Action Required:
Please confirm receipt of this alert and ensure pharmacy staff are on standby to receive the shipment at the updated time. The cold-vault handoff will reset the thermal clock, so the insulin will arrive in optimal condition.

For any questions or concerns, contact the Sindh Emergency Management Line: +92-21-4455667.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this critical matter.

BioRoute Emergency Orchestrator
16 May 2026 | 14:30 PKT
